segments.title: Living in Harmony Awards Status Update
segments.takeaway: Kandice Parker provided an update on the Living in Harmony Awards, noting low participation in recent years and the decision to pause the program for a year to develop a new strategy.

segments.title: Historical Context and Promotion of the Awards
segments.takeaway: A committee member shared the historical context of the awards, detailing past promotional efforts like thousands of posters, formal ceremonies, and community engagement events.

segments.title: Rethinking and Rebranding the Awards
segments.takeaway: Committee members discussed rethinking the awards, considering a return to their roots, expanding categories to include digital media, and potentially rebranding the program for greater relevance and

segments.title: Administrative Support and Community Engagement Strategy
segments.takeaway: The discussion focused on the need for administrative support, rebuilding relationships with school boards and community partners, and identifying champions to help revitalize the awards program.

segments.title: Showcase Model and Public Display Ideas

segments.title: Motion to Receive Information and Subcommittee Volunteers
segments.takeaway: A motion was made to receive the information, and a committee member volunteered to join the Living in Harmony subcommittee to help rethink the awards for the future.

segments.title: Work Plan Update and Approval
segments.takeaway: The committee reviewed and approved the work plan, which included updating terms of reference, collaborating with the REDI office, and gathering feedback, for submission to SBCM.
